brief:
Yair Netanyahu, the far-right activist son of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, plans to release a book claiming state institutions have conspired to bring down his father, Middle East Eye reported. The book will focus on what he characterizes as a "deep state war" against the prime minister.

Sara Netanyahu is also mentioned in connection with the project, though specific details about her involvement remain unclear from the available information.
dek: Yair Netanyahu to release book on 'deep state' war against his father Submitted by Alex MacDonald on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 09:46 Far-right activist son of Israeli prime minister blames state institutions for plotting to bring down his father Sara Netanyahu…
title: Yair Netanyahu plans book on alleged 'deep state' plot against father
